SELECT
  tenant_name,
  ticket_count,
  round(pct_of_total_tickets, 1) AS pct_of_total_tickets,
  round(sum(pct_of_total_tickets) OVER (ORDER BY ticket_count DESC, tenant_name), 1) AS cumulative_pct_of_total_tickets,
  round(first_response_breach_rate, 1) AS first_response_breach_rate,
  round(resolution_breach_rate, 1) AS resolution_breach_rate,
  round(avg_resolution_minutes, 1) AS avg_resolution_minutes,
  agent_count,
  total_tenants_with_tickets
FROM (
  SELECT
    t.name AS tenant_name,
    tk.tenant_id,
    tk.ticket_count,
    100.0 * tk.ticket_count / tot.total_tickets AS pct_of_total_tickets,
    100.0 * coalesce(frb.breach_count, 0) / nullif(tk.sla_ticket_count, 0) AS first_response_breach_rate,
    100.0 * coalesce(rb.breach_count, 0) / nullif(tk.sla_ticket_count, 0) AS resolution_breach_rate,
    tk.avg_resolution_minutes,
    (SELECT count(DISTINCT sa.id) FROM support_agents sa WHERE sa.tenant_id = tk.tenant_id) AS agent_count,
    tot.total_tickets,
    tnt.total_tenants_with_tickets
  FROM (
    SELECT
      tenant_id,
      count(*) AS ticket_count,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE sla_policy_id IS NOT NULL) AS sla_ticket_count,
      avg(extract(epoch FROM (resolved_at - created_at)) / 60.0) FILTER (WHERE resolved_at IS NOT NULL) AS avg_resolution_minutes
    FROM tickets
    WHERE created_at >= timestamp '2025-01-01' AND created_at < timestamp '2026-01-01'
    GROUP BY tenant_id
  ) tk
  JOIN tenants t ON t.id = tk.tenant_id
  CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT count(*) AS total_tickets
    FROM tickets
    WHERE created_at >= timestamp '2025-01-01' AND created_at < timestamp '2026-01-01'
  ) tot
  CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT count(DISTINCT tenant_id) AS total_tenants_with_tickets
    FROM tickets
    WHERE created_at >= timestamp '2025-01-01' AND created_at < timestamp '2026-01-01'
  ) tnt
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT sb.tenant_id, count(*) AS breach_count
    FROM sla_breaches sb
    JOIN tickets tk2 ON tk2.id = sb.ticket_id
    WHERE sb.breach_kind = 'first_response'
      AND tk2.created_at >= timestamp '2025-01-01' AND tk2.created_at < timestamp '2026-01-01'
      AND tk2.sla_policy_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY sb.tenant_id
  ) frb ON frb.tenant_id = tk.tenant_id
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT sb.tenant_id, count(*) AS breach_count
    FROM sla_breaches sb
    JOIN tickets tk3 ON tk3.id = sb.ticket_id
    WHERE sb.breach_kind = 'resolution'
      AND tk3.created_at >= timestamp '2025-01-01' AND tk3.created_at < timestamp '2026-01-01'
      AND tk3.sla_policy_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY sb.tenant_id
  ) rb ON rb.tenant_id = tk.tenant_id
) x
ORDER BY ticket_count DESC, tenant_name
LIMIT 30
note: Printed to the top 30 tenants by 2025 ticket volume, ordered desc with cumulative share computed over all tenants before truncation. Added a `total_tenants_with_tickets` column (constant across rows) so the analyst has the total merchant count with ≥1 ticket in 2025 without a separate query; agent_count uses support_agents.tenant_id directly per the "simpler" option noted in the request.
